thesis: The episode introduces Virginie Morgon, CEO of Eurazeo, and outlines the show's focus on her career path from investment banking to private equity leadership. The transcript details her early international experience, her 17-year tenure at Lazard where she helped merge three distinct houses, and her transition to Eurazeo in 2007.
